start_from: Original Base weights and fresh Adam; do not inherit seed42 fitted weights
first_outer: Generate 1024 once; all three reuse arms share its exact first64 responses and caches
later_outers: Each arm generates from its own current weights; refresh anchor and restore Adam
nesting: Next 1024-prompt block each outer; reuse arms take its first64; no within-seed repeats
heldout: Same original 128 fixed response prefixes; same 194 task questions and evaluation seeds
limits: Three total data/rollout seeds including the original; not a large-seed study.
Eight outers do not establish the 100-outer endpoint or reproduce the paper budget.
Token visits and compute differ; both are recorded, not equated by response count.
Same local prompt and EOS-coarsened objective; algorithm and instruction controls remain separate.
Seeds are fixed before replication outcomes; no outcome-based selection of bank contents.
